findings.why_it_matters: The dedup table, its payload_hash conflict detection, and the SAVEPOINT-free race handling all exist to make a replayed event_id a no-op, but no production caller can ever replay an event_id: every call site generates a brand new uuid4. So the retry the design is built for happens anyway. A designer double-clicks 'pass', or the client retries after a lost response, and pass_check — which unlike record_actual_data and confirm_actual_data has no state precondition at all — runs a second time and emits a second actual_data_replaces_design under a new id. P8 later walks the event chain to reverse-restore: it now finds two events for one equipment, and the second one's `before` equals the first one's `after`, so restoring in order writes back actual data as if it were design data, and the original design value is unrecoverable. The table also grows by one never-reusable row per emit, forever.
findings.suggested_fix: Derive event_id deterministically from the business operation instead of calling uuid4, so a retry of the same operation necessarily re-presents the same id and the existing dedup path does its job. E.g. `uuid.uuid5(NS_EVENT, f"replaces_design:{equipment.equipment_id}:{payload_hash}")`. ASSUMPTION: two genuinely distinct confirm operations on the same equipment must not collide — including the payload in the key gives each distinct payload its own id, which is the behaviour the caller wants anyway. Independently, add the missing CONFIRMED-state precondition to pass_check so the double-submit is rejected at the service layer rather than relying on dedup.

findings.why_it_matters: The four-eyes control this router exists to enforce is bypassable by any user holding the REVIEWER role alone. `check_actual_data` loads the equipment and calls `pass_check_svc` unconditionally; `pass_check` writes `actual_data_status = CONFIRMED` and flushes with no check on the current status. A REVIEWER who has project access can therefore drive an equipment from `NOT_ENTERED` (no designer ever typed a single value, no deviation report ever generated, no designer ever submitted) straight to `CONFIRMED`, and the router returns 200 with `actual_data_status: "CONFIRMED"`. The downstream effect is not cosmetic: `pass_check` fires the `actual_data_replaces_design` event with `before=equipment.design_parameters_json` and `after=equipment.actual_data_json` — for a never-entered machine `after` is `None` — and the confirmation gate (`can_confirm`, the whole fail-closed deviation engine of S4-2) lives only in `confirm_actual_data`, which this path never reaches. The resulting `CONFIRMED` status is exactly what `record_actual_data` treats as the lock that forbids re-entry (`ACTUAL_DATA_LOCKED`), so the equipment is permanently frozen against the designer who was supposed to fill it in. `reject_check` has the mirror-image gap: it resets a `CONFIRMED` record to `PENDING_CONFIRM` with no precondition, which unlocks the re-entry channel on any record. The fix is the repo's own guard pattern applied at the service boundary — raise `PcsError(409/422, ...)` when `equipment.actual_data_status` is not `PENDING_CONFIRM` before either transition, mirroring how `record_actual_data` already gates on `CONFIRMED`.
findings.suggested_fix:
Add a precondition and a re-gate at the top of `pass_check`, mirroring the shape already used by `confirm_actual_data` (same module, same `_error` helper):

```python
if equipment.actual_data_status != ActualDataStatus.PENDING_CONFIRM.value:
    raise _error(
        "ACTUAL_DATA_NOT_SUBMITTED",
        f"实际数据当前为 {equipment.actual_data_status} —— 校核通过前须由设计人先提交确认",
        status=409,
    )

report = build_report(equipment)
if not can_confirm(report):
    raise _error(
        "DEVIATION_BLOCKS_CONFIRMATION",
        f"存在不合格或不可判项，禁止校核通过：{report.blocking_reason}",
    )
```

This closes both the direct bypass and the re-entry TOCTOU, because the gate is re-evaluated at check time against whatever `actual_data_json` is currently stored. ASSUMPTION: PENDING_CONFIRM is the intended single value for "submitted and awaiting check" — the module docstring (lines 55-57) states this explicitly ("PENDING_CONFIRM 同时覆盖「待确认」与「校核中」两段"), so no new enum value or migration is needed. Note that adding this guard will break `test_pass_check_marks_confirmed`, `test_pass_check_emits_event_with_before`, `test_pass_check_does_not_touch_sign_status_hash` and `test_reject_check_reopens_entry`, which all call `pass_check` on a NOT_ENTERED fixture; those fixtures need a prior `confirm_actual_data` call. A same-shaped guard on `reject_check` (only unlock from CONFIRMED/PENDING_CONFIRM) is worth adding in the same pass, though it is lower impact.

Executed export with `actual_data_json = {"=cmd|'/c calc'!A0": {"value": 1.0, "unit": ""}, ...}`; reloading the produced workbook with openpyxl printed `B2 "=cmd|'/c calc'!A0" f`. The `f` data type is openpyxl's marker for a formula cell — the payload is stored as executable formula, not as text.
findings.why_it_matters: `ActualDataEntry.name` is an arbitrary string from the designer's PUT body (`Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)`, no character restriction). `build_report` iterates `for name in actual:` and every row's `parameter` field carries that string verbatim into the workbook. openpyxl does not escape a leading `=`, so the cell is persisted as a live formula. I confirmed this end to end: with `name = "=cmd|'/c calc'!A0"` the exported workbook round-trips as `B2 "=cmd|'/c calc'!A0" f` — `f` is openpyxl's formula data type. The attacker is any DESIGNER or PROCESS_CONTROLLER on the project (the export is VIEWER-gated, so the file reaches every viewer and any downstream recipient of the export); the victim is whoever opens the file in Excel, where the formula evaluates. On older Excel that is DDE / command execution; on current Excel the reliable payload is `=HYPERLINK(...)` or an external-cell-reference exfiltration of the workbook's own contents. Because the write role and the read role are different people here, this is a stored, cross-role delivery mechanism: a designer plants it, a viewer or process engineer trips it. The same unescaped value also reaches `unit` (column E) and, via `tag_number`, column A.
findings.suggested_fix:
Neutralize formula-injection on every string cell before it reaches openpyxl. The standard OWASP mitigation is a leading-apostrophe prefix, which Excel renders as text and which round-trips safely:


findings.title: [A03/CWE-20] The strict-float contract on `ActualDataEntry.value` is enforced only by Pydantic's lax coercion, so the service's own string/bool rejection is unreachable dead code on the API path
findings.first_evidence: pcs-backend/app/schemas/supplier.py:23 — `    value: float = Field(description="实测值 (可为负, 如冬季设计温度)")`
evidence: pcs-backend/app/schemas/supplier.py:23 — `    value: float = Field(description="实测值 (可为负, 如冬季设计温度)")` — a bare `float` with no `Field(strict=True)` and no `allow_inf_nan=False`.

Executed against the real `ActualDataEntry` model: `'100' -> 100.0`, `True -> 1.0`, `'NaN' -> nan`, `'Infinity' -> inf`, `None REJECT ValidationError`. Pydantic lax mode coerces the exact inputs that `actual_data_service.py:33-39` `_coerce_value` exists to reject.

pcs-backend/app/services/supplier/actual_data_service.py:35 — `    if isinstance(raw, bool) or not isinstance(raw, (int, float)):` — unreachable from the router, because `model_dump()` at `supplier.py:121` yields `value` as an already-coerced `float`.

pcs-backend/app/services/supplier/deviation_service.py:249 — `        return Evaluation(QUALIFIED, deviation)` is the fall-through of `ASYMMETRIC_BAND`; with `deviation = nan` both guards at lines 245 and 247 compare false, so execution lands here. Executed: `扬程 QUALIFIED nan` and `can_confirm = True` for `actual_data_json={'扬程':{'value':float('nan'),...}}` against a design value of 2100.0.

The persistence leg was checked against the live database and does not hold: `PostgreSQL 18.6`, `jsonb NaN ERR: asyncpg.exceptions.InvalidTextRepresentationError`. This is why severity is P2 rather than P0 — the gate bypass is demonstrable in-process but not yet reachable through stored data.
findings.why_it_matters: Both the schema docstring ("value 严格数值 —— 字符串数字在 UI 上是录入错误, 不是可容忍的输入") and `actual_data_service._coerce_value` (docstring: "不接受 '100' 这类字符串数字", with an explicit `isinstance(raw, bool)` rejection) state that string numerics and booleans must be refused. Neither guard actually fires on the router path, because Pydantic v2 runs first in lax mode and hands the service an already-coerced `float`. Verified against the real schema: `'100' -> 100.0`, `True -> 1.0`, `'NaN' -> nan`, `'Infinity' -> inf`. So the service's boolean branch is unreachable from `PUT /actual-data` and the string-digit rule is not enforced at all. The security-relevant edge is that non-finite floats survive validation: `float('nan')` reaches `deviation_service.evaluate`, where every comparison against NaN is false, so the `ASYMMETRIC_BAND` rule falls through to `return Evaluation(QUALIFIED, deviation)` — I verified `can_confirm` returns `True` for a pump whose entire actual-data set is `{"扬程": {"value": NaN}}`, i.e. a value that was never measured would clear the SPEC §3.2.4(4) confirmation gate. That specific bypass does not reach production today: PostgreSQL 18.6 rejects `NaN` as a JSONB literal (`InvalidTextRepresentationError` on `select 'NaN'::jsonb`), so the write fails with a 500 rather than persisting — the practical impact today is an unhandled 500 on a request a client can trigger, not a confirmed forged value. I file it at P2 and 75 for that reason: the validation contract the code documents is not the contract the code enforces, and the moment a non-finite value becomes storable — or a numeric-typed column replaces the JSONB — the NaN-to-QUALIFIED path becomes live.
findings.suggested_fix:
Make the schema enforce the contract it documents, so the service-level checks become defence in depth rather than the only (unreachable) defence:

```python
value: float = Field(
    description="实测值 (可为负, 如冬季设计温度)",
    strict=True,
    allow_inf_nan=False,
)
```

`strict=True` rejects `'100'` and `True` at the boundary, matching both docstrings; `allow_inf_nan=False` closes the NaN/Infinity path into `evaluate` regardless of storage format. This is a breaking change for any client currently sending string numerics, which is precisely the behaviour the two docstrings say should not be tolerated — worth confirming against the frontend types (`pcs-frontend/src/types/api.d.ts` is in this diff) before applying. Assumption: no legitimate caller depends on lax numeric coercion; if one does, the fix is to fix that caller, not to widen the field.

findings.title: build_report's `design_value is None` short-circuit preempts kind dispatch, so MANUAL_CHECK rows lose requires_manual_check and report a misleading note
findings.first_evidence: pcs-backend/app/services/supplier/deviation_report.py:104 — `        if design_value is None:` followed by `            rows.append(DeviationRow(... verdict=UNVERDICTABLE, note="缺设计值，无法判定", spec_ref=rule.spec_ref,))` and `            continue` — the kind-specific branch in `evaluate` is never reached
evidence: pcs-backend/app/services/supplier/deviation_report.py:104 — `        if design_value is None:` followed by `            rows.append(DeviationRow(... verdict=UNVERDICTABLE, note="缺设计值，无法判定", spec_ref=rule.spec_ref,))` and `            continue` — the kind-specific branch in `evaluate` is never reached
pcs-backend/app/services/supplier/deviation_service.py:224-231 — `    if rule.kind == "REFERENCE_ONLY":` … `            note="参照量，本身不判合格与否（供其他规则使用）",` — documented as valid data, not missing data

pcs-backend/app/services/equip_list/pump_design_data.py:83-91 — `_UNITS` contains only 扬程/效率/NPSHr/轴功率/电机额定功率/电机配用功率/转速; 材质 and 厂家型号 have no design-side representation at all, so the short-circuit is the normal path, not an edge case
findings.why_it_matters: `evaluate()` in `deviation_service.py` dispatches on `rule.kind` FIRST (lines 212-231): MANUAL_CHECK returns UNVERDICTABLE with `requires_manual_check=True` and the note 「序数比较（不得低于），机器判不了 —— 需人工核对」; REFERENCE_ONLY and RECHECK_ALWAYS return without needing a design value at all. But `build_report` checks `if design_value is None` and `continue`s before ever calling `evaluate`, so for any rule whose kind is not numeric the missing-design short-circuit wins. For 材质 — one of the six rows SPEC §3.2.4(2) explicitly enumerates, and which by definition has no numeric design value in `design_parameters_json` — an engineer entering 材质 gets a row that says 「缺设计值，无法判定」 (a claim that is false; nothing is missing) with `requires_manual_check=False` and `spec_ref` populated. The dropped `requires_manual_check` flag is the part that actually hurts: it is the signal a downstream consumer (and the exported report) would use to route the row to a human instead of treating it as a data-entry defect, and `DeviationRowOut` carries it to the API. The same ordering also silently downgrades REFERENCE_ONLY (轴功率, documented at deviation_service.py:224-231 as 「本身不判合格与否」 and deliberately marked QUALIFIED) to UNVERDICTABLE for any equipment whose `design_parameters_json` has not been populated by `apply_design_parameters` yet.
findings.suggested_fix:
Let the kind decide whether a design value is required. Add a class-level set of kinds that never consult the design value, and move the `design_value is None` check below it:

```python
# deviation_service.py
DESIGN_VALUE_OPTIONAL_KINDS = frozenset(
    {"MANUAL_CHECK", "REFERENCE_ONLY", "RECHECK_ALWAYS"}
)

# deviation_report.py, inside build_report, replacing the current
# `if design_value is None:` block at line 104
if design_value is None and rule.kind not in DESIGN_VALUE_OPTIONAL_KINDS:
    rows.append(DeviationRow(... verdict=UNVERDICTABLE, note="缺设计值，无法判定", ...))
    continue
```

With that, 材质 rows reach `evaluate`, carry the correct 「需人工核对」 note and `requires_manual_check=True`, and 轴功率 rows report as valid reference data instead of missing data. ASSUMPTION: these three kinds are genuinely design-value-independent by the engine's own documented semantics — MANUAL_CHECK is an ordinal comparison, REFERENCE_ONLY is explicitly 「本身不判合格与否」, and RECHECK_ALWAYS already returns a fixed WARNING with `deviation_pct=None` so the design value only ever feeds the (currently unused) displayed number. If the team instead wants RECHECK_ALWAYS to stay blocking when no design speed exists, drop it from the frozenset and the behaviour for 转速 is unchanged from today.

No 叶轮直径 key exists anywhere in `PUMP_DESIGN` or `_UNITS`, so there is no correct design value to pair. Give 叶轮直径 its own rule rather than aliasing it onto 转速, so `design_key` and the actual parameter stay the same name.     parameter="叶轮直径",
    kind="RECHECK_ALWAYS",
    spec_ref="SPEC §3.2.4(2) 实际转速、叶轮直径：允许差异，需重新校核性能",
